name: paranoid_dataset
description: A text dataset focused on examples exhibiting paranoid content or paranoid-style statements, intended to evaluate models' ability to detect, classify, or appropriately respond to paranoid or mental-health-related language. It is primarily used for safety and robustness testing of NLP models.
reputation: A small, specialized safety-oriented dataset hosted on Hugging Face with limited but growing use in model robustness evaluations.
